name: gitdrives
description: Git-backed drives (mirror): clone a repository (GitHub, Azure DevOps Git/TFS Git) into DocIndex and keep it in sync with pull-then-scan. Read-only.
help: Git drives mirror a remote Git repository (GitHub, Azure DevOps Git, TFS Git — TFVC centralizado não é suportado) as a read-only DocIndex drive: files are indexed and searchable like any synced drive.

Create one with the repository URL, branch (default: remote HEAD) and, for private repos, a username plus personal access token (stored encrypted). The first sync clones; later syncs pull and re-scan.
Removing a git drive only deletes DocIndex rows and the local clone cache — the remote repository is never touched.
